```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

airbnb_data_final_cleaned <- read.csv("data/airbnb_nyc_final_clean.csv")

head(airbnb_data_final_cleaned)
```

### 空间连接 (Spatial Join / Relational Data)

使用 `sf` 包执行空间连接，将 ACS 的社会经济变量附加到每个房源上.

```{R}
# 1. 将 Airbnb 数据（data.frame）转换为 sf 点对象
airbnb_data_final_cleaned_sf <- airbnb_data_final_cleaned %>%
  filter(!is.na(long) & !is.na(lat)) %>% # 确保有坐标
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326) # WGS84 坐标系

# 2. 确保 ACS 数据的坐标系 (CRS) 与 listings 一致
nyc_acs_data_transformed <- st_transform(nyc_acs_data, crs = 4326)

# 3. 执行空间连接 (st_join)
joined_data_sf <- st_join(airbnb_data_final_cleaned_sf, nyc_acs_data_transformed, join = st_intersects)

# 4. （可选）移除空间对象，转为普通 data.frame 以便建模
final_analytics_base_table <- joined_data_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  as.data.frame()
  
head(final_analytics_base_table)

final_analytics_base_table_wide <- final_analytics_base_table %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate, id_cols = id)
```

```{r}
write_csv(final_analytics_base_table, "data/final_analytics_base_table.csv")
```

SQL for wide table and more cleaning

```{r}
final_analytics_base_table_wide <- read_csv(
  "data/final_analytics_base_table_wide_clean.csv",
  quote = "\"",
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_names = FALSE
)

nrow(final_analytics_base_table_wide)

colnames(final_analytics_base_table_wide) <- c(
  "id", "name", "host_id", "host_identity_verified", "host_name",
  "neighbourhood_group", "neighbourhood", "instant_bookable",
  "cancellation_policy", "room_type", "construction_year", "price",
  "service_fee", "minimum_nights", "number_of_reviews", "last_review",
  "reviews_per_month", "review_rate_number", "calculated_host_listings_count",
  "availability_365", "house_rules", "GEOID_x", "NAME_x",
  "median_income", "population", "median_rent"
)
```

```{r}
write_csv(final_analytics_base_table_wide, "data/final_data.csv")
```
